div.p: Specifies the authoritative source or rules for values used to identify the type of relation between the entity being described in the EAS instance and the related entity.

relationTypeEncoding specifies the authoritative source or rules for values supplied in relationType within relation. If the value "EASList" is selected, addressLineType will be expected with the values "...". If the value "otherRelationTypeEncoding" is selected, an alternate code list should be specified in conventionDeclaration. This optional attribute is available only in control.
